text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Digi-tan believes this... To be a 
true all-rounder, one must enter both the 
turf and dirt Mile Championships!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And with that, we arrived in Morioka, 
the host city for the Mile Championship 
Nambu Hai.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nfufu! Mile... I'm bowled over— Over here 
at the 'Mile Championship Nambu Hai'!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yours truly, Digi-tan, has trained herself 
to the bone through rain and wind, all for 
this very day...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! With this dialect I've mastered 
through countless trials...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll nail it— flawless communication with 
the locals!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Those adorable earmuffs 
recognizable from a mile away, and that 
fluffy tail reflecting such a gentle 
personality— Could you be none other than 
Morioka's own horse girl, Yukino-san!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you got it~! I happened to be 
visiting home, so I came over to cheer for 
ya~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Here's a snack from Morioka. Have some 
before a race, or whenever you get 
hungry~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that, Trainer?! Taking 
precious time out of her visit home, 
Yukino-san came just to cheer for little 
old me!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And even souvenirs too! Those famous, 
crispy, fragrant Nanbu rice crackers...!!
choice_data_list: I really need to show what I'm made of!
I really need to show what I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes sir!! Meeting your fave's expectations 
with all your might! That is the true way 
of an otaku!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am!! Answering my oshi's 
expectations with everything I've got! 
That is the true way of an otaku!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To deliver a run worthy of my oshi, and to 
burn the sight of a naturally charming 
Tohoku girl's stride into my retinas—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan's gonna blast off at full 
throttle, you betcha~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rejuvenated by Yukino Bijin's precious 
cheer, Agnes Digital headed toward the 
waiting room in high spirits.
